eyebrow: Scale on GPU utilization, not CPU
code:
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: inference-hpa
spec:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
    - type: Pods
      pods:
        metric:
          name: DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL
        target:
          type: AverageValue
          averageValue: "70"
caption: DCGM exporter + Prometheus Adapter feed the real GPU signal into HPA; minReplicas: 2 pre-warms.

code:
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: bursty-inference-scaler
spec:
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 5
  triggers:
    - type: prometheus
      metadata:
        metricName: inference_queue_depth
        threshold: "5"
caption: Zero replicas while idle; the tradeoff is cold-start latency on the next request.
